result.summary: 本文提出 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，可生成 1080p 高清视频及同步音频，并支持指令式视频编辑和基于用户图像的个性化视频生成 [abstract]。最大的视频生成模型是 30B 参数 Transformer，最大上下文长度 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的视频 [abstract]。模型在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上取得新的最优结果 [abstract]。作者还公开了两个基准 Movie Gen Video Bench 和 Movie Gen Audio Bench，以支持未来评测 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合和预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间 [S1.p1]。作者希望验证：通过同时扩展训练数据、计算量和模型参数，简单的 Transformer 模型结合 Flow Matching 能否得到高质量的媒体生成模型 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
While Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to learn such capabilities with a text output space, in this paper we focus on media – image, video, audio – as the output space.
We find that scaling the training data, compute, and model parameters of a simple Transformer-based model trained with Flow Matching yields high quality generative models for video or audio.

method.text: Movie Gen 包含两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。视频模型采用基于 LLaMa3 的 Transformer 骨干，并做了三处修改：加入跨注意力文本条件、加入自适应层归一化引入时间步、使用全双向注意力 [S3.SS1.SSS3.p3]。训练目标采用 Flow Matching，作者称其天然保证零终端 SNR，且比扩散损失更稳健 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。个性化视频通过 PT2V 条件化参考图像身份特征实现 [S4.SS1.p1]，视频编辑则采用多阶段训练，包括图像编辑与视频生成的多任务训练、合成多帧编辑任务微调以及基于回译的微调 [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: Movie Gen Video. A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
We build our Transformer backbone by closely following the Transformer block used in the LLaMa3 architecture.

To incorporate text conditioning based on the text prompt embedding $\mathbf{P}$, we add a cross-attention module between the self-attention module and the feed forward network (FFN) to each Transformer block.
We add adaptive layer norm blocks to incorporate the time-step $t$ to the Transformer, as used in prior work.
We use full bi-directional attention instead of causal attention used in language modeling.
Empirically, we found that Flow Matching was more robust to the exact choice of noise schedules and it outperforms diffusion losses

We extend our 30B Movie Gen Video model for Personalized Text-to-Video generation, PT2V, by conditioning the model on the identity information extracted from an input reference image in addition to the text prompt.
in the first stage we train the text-to-video model with a multi-tasking objective that alternates between image editing, which we treat as single-frame video editing, and video generation
in the second stage we introduce two new synthetic tasks that more closely resemble multi-frame video editing and finetune the model on them
in the third and final stage, we introduce an adaptation of backtranslation for video editing, enabling us to train the model on multi-frame, high-quality output videos.

experiments.text: 文本到视频评测采用人工 A/B 成对比较，并公开了包含 1003 条提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench，覆盖人类活动、动物、自然风景、物理等概念 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。作者与 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs、Kling1.5 以及 OpenAI Sora 等系统进行比较 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p1]。消融实验使用 5B 参数、生成 352×192、4–8 秒视频的较小模型，在 Movie Gen Video Bench-Mini 的 381 条提示上评测 [S3.SS6.SSS2.p1][S3.SS6.SSS2.p2]。音频评测使用 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 以及包含 527 个视频的 Movie Gen Audio Bench [S6.SS3.SSS2.p3]。视频编辑评测使用 TGVE+ 和新提出的 Movie Gen Edit Bench，后者验证集 64 个视频、测试集 128 个视频 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: we publicly release a benchmark, Movie Gen Video Bench 1 1 1 https://github.com/facebookresearch/MovieGenBench, which consists of 1003 prompts
We specifically include prompts capturing the following concepts of interest: 1) human activity (limb and mouth motion, emotions, etc.), 2) animals, 3) nature and scenery, 4) physics
This includes the black-box commercial models that offer API access through their website: Runway Gen3, LumaLabs, Kling1.5.
We also compare to closed source text-to-video methods (OpenAI Sora)
We analyze the effect of each design decision quantitatively via text-to-video human evaluation on a subset of Movie Gen Video Bench containing 381 prompts, termed Movie Gen Video Bench-Mini
We use a $5$ B parameter version of Movie Gen Video trained to produce $352\times 192$ videos of $4$ – $8$ s.
This includes VGGSound, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen3, and our proposed Movie Gen Audio Bench.
It includes 527 videos and is designed to cover various ambient environments
Overall, the benchmark validation set has 64 videos, whereas the test set has 128 videos.
We evaluate the capabilities of our model against two main video editing benchmarks. The first benchmark, TGVE+, is a recently proposed extension of the TGVE benchmark.

findings.text: 在文本到视频整体质量上，Movie Gen Video 大幅优于 Runway Gen3（净胜率 35.02%）和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 取得中等净胜（8.23%），与 Kling1.5 持平（3.87%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。消融显示，基于 LLaMa3 的架构在质量和文本对齐上分别显著优于 Diffusion Transformer 18.6% 和 12.6% [S3.SS6.SSS2.p6]。模型规模从 5B 到 30B 的缩放行为与 LLaMa3 缩放定律高度吻合 [S3.SS6.SSS2.p7]。音频方面，Movie Gen Audio 在所有指标上大幅优于基线，同步性净胜 33.8% 至 72.8%，生成视频整体质量净胜 31.3% 至 91.0% [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3]。视频编辑方面，在 TGVE+ 基准上人类评估偏好 Movie Gen Edit 比当前最优 EVE 高 74% [S5.SS3.SSS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 $\sigma$) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
we find that our LLaMa3 based architecture significantly outperforms the Diffusion Transformer on both quality (18.6%) and text-alignment (12.6%).
we find that these optimal models align very closely with the LLaMa3 scaling law.
with 33.8% to 72.8% on synchronization, 27.5% to 82.2% on correctness for all videos, and 31.3% to 91.0% on overall quality for generated videos.
On the TGVE+ benchmark, our model is preferred 74% more often than the current state-of-the-art EVE in the overall Human evaluation criterion.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在伪影 [S8.p2]。生成音频在运动密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、或需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时不同步，且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。模型分别针对视频和音频训练，联合生成这些模态仍是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。此外，使用人工评估定义客观标准仍然困难，可能受个人偏见、背景等因素影响 [S8.p2]。研究仅限英文文本输入 [S8.p3]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense ( e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded ( e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
Our study in this paper is limited to text inputs in the English language.
